## Change
Describe the bounded change and why it is needed.

## Risk tier
- [ ] FAST
- [ ] STANDARD
- [ ] DEEP

## Evidence
- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:container`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Security impact reviewed
- [ ] No secrets or production credentials added

## Authority boundaries
- [ ] No automatic merge
- [ ] No production deploy or release
- [ ] No productive writeback
- [ ] Human Accept still required where applicable

## Exact head
Record the reviewed/tested commit SHA here:

`<SHA>`

## Human action
State the exact remaining decision or action required from the human reviewer.
